subject.title: refactor(whatsapp): centralize inbound turn admission and history finalization

question: Should `mapChannelIngressDecisionToTurnAdmission` remain a public export of the experimental `plugin-sdk/channel-ingress-runtime` API, rather than staying a core-private helper consumed only by WhatsApp?
rationale: The patch is structurally coherent, but adding a public Plugin SDK function establishes an extension contract beyond this refactor; repository policy requires explicit owner-visible direction for such API surface changes.

options.title: Approve the SDK mapper contract
options.body: Keep the documented export and baseline update, treating the ingress-decision mapper as the shared receive-path API for migrated channel plugins.

options.title: Keep the mapper internal
options.body: Move the mapper behind a core-private boundary and keep WhatsApp-specific adaptation local until more channel consumers establish the public contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the SDK mapper contract
recommendation.body: Keep the documented export and baseline update, treating the ingress-decision mapper as the shared receive-path API for migrated channel plugins.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current channel-turn and SDK-boundary refactor and can supply the implementation context for the owner decision.
